description: A warrior who uses martial prowess and nature magic to combat threats on the edges of civilization.

properties.name: Ranger
properties.description: Far from the bustle of cities and towns, past the hedges that shelter the most distant farms from the terrors of the wild, amid the dense-packed trees of trackless forests and across wide and empty plains, rangers keep their unending watch.

subclasses.name: Hunter
subclasses.description: Emulates the specialized hunting techniques used by wild beasts and seasoned woodsmen.

subclasses.name: Beast Master
subclasses.description: Bonds with a beast companion, fighting as a coordinated partnership.
